text_block_list.text:
The annual Summer Training Camp has
begun. 
Yaeno Muteki shows great motivation to 
overcome her weaknesses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan and Sakura Chiyono O were 
also more pumped up than ever.
It looks to 
be a fulfilling training camp.
